name: @bridge/desktop
description: Bridge desktop shell (Tauri v2) — the first-built of the three thin clients (Notion model). HOSTS apps/web (devUrl in dev, apps/web/dist in prod) and adds what only a native shell can: the Rust capture core implementing the @bridge/sensors context-provider SPI (desktop subset) + the overlay avatar. No kernel logic lives here.

scripts.build: echo 'desktop shell: JS build is a no-op — build the shell via `pnpm tauri build` (requires Rust; frontend comes from apps/web/dist)'
scripts.test: echo 'desktop shell: no JS tests — Rust tests run via `cargo test` in src-tauri'
